scope: Static source audit, CPU typed-default inspection, eight read-only plans and 45 CPU regression cases; no GPU training/evaluation launched by this audit.

regressions.scope: Bookkeeping tests use real torch checkpoint files and fake processes; actual Isaac/ONNX physical evidence is separately reported.

findings.detail: Image source 64ebc5f can return early for a passed target without checking input settings. Mounted patch compares resolved environment count, stage registry order, FINETUNE and ordered teacher SHA before reusing any checkpoint; target extension is allowed. Missing legacy provenance with an existing PT fails closed.

Final teacher graph missing, changed, invalid or mismatched iteration/registry stops official driver. A passed teacher PT is not retrained merely to recreate a deleted graph. Native training save/export errors mark failed and can resume. Do not replace a 64-variant training graph with a 1-variant evaluation export.

Native checkpoints restore model/optimizer/iteration. WBT inherits empty BaseTask environment checkpoint state; motion sampling history, WBT curriculum and RNG/simulator state are not persisted. Resume is not bitwise continuation and repeats the saved zero-based iteration.

Evaluation verifies finite actions/root states, exact steps*env tracking samples, source PT SHA, fresh readable videos and TensorBoard. It records failure/timeout counts and tracking errors but does not impose learned-skill/convergence thresholds; poor policies can pass execution acceptance.

Official evaluation uses 64 environments x 3000 steps (60 simulated seconds/env at dt0.02), teacher1variant and student3variants. Clip/expert IDs are reported; exhaustive coverage of each motion or 64 training layouts is not guaranteed.

Teacher validation checks full graph, 29-joint metadata, embedded references, iteration and registry, with 12 real CPU cases. Student export recovers exact saved pure/finetune config and teacher-slot count, loads full checkpoint, then checks two fresh graphs with 30 real CPU cases and deployment metadata. This is not PT/ONNX numerical parity or policy quality.

Training resume/skip binds registry URI, not every in-place data byte. Keep the separately checksum-verified asset bundles immutable; changing content under the same file:// URI requires a fresh output directory.

The complete official driver uses all five ordered skills and requires each teacher iter>=19999 before student training. The generic pipeline --skills option permits an explicitly requested subset; that is not the full five-expert recipe.
